events.title: GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: How to teach Copilot about your codebase
events.summary: Learn how to add custom instructions and skills to your repository, use custom agents, and connect MCP servers like Playwright. Context matters when you’re working with AI. Every codebase has its own house rules: how components are structured, which scripts to run, and which conventions apply to different frameworks and file types.
